quranTranslation.text: And to the three also (did He turn in mercy) who were left behind, when the earth, vast as it is, was straitened for them, and their own souls were straitened for them till they bethought them that there is no refuge from Allah save toward Him. Then turned He unto them in mercy that they (too) might turn (repentant unto Him). Lo! Allah! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: „Zatim im je primio pokajanje da bi se pokajali“ – تَابَ za Allaha i za ljude u istom ajetu.
explanation.en: “Then turned He unto them in mercy that they (too) might turn (repentant unto Him)” — تَابَ of Allah and of people in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: Adem je primio riječi od Gospodara, pa mu je On oprostio – Allahovo primanje pokajanja.
explanation.en: Adam received words from his Lord, and He accepted his repentance.

quranTranslation.text: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -

explanation.bs: Ko se pokaje i čini dobro, on se Allahu istinski vraća – pokajanje uz dobro djelo.
explanation.en: Whoever repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with a true turning — repentance with good deeds.

quranTranslation.text: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.

explanation.bs: Davud je pao ničice i Allahu se obratio – vraćanje poslije iskušenja.
explanation.en: David fell down bowing and turned in repentance — returning after a trial.

quranTranslation.text: Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom, when ye cannot be helped.

explanation.bs: „I obratite se svome Gospodaru i predajte Mu se prije nego što vas stigne kazna.“
explanation.en: “Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom.”

quranTranslation.text: He said: O my people! Bethink you: if I am (acting) on a clear proof from my Lord and He sustaineth me with fair sustenance from Him (how can I concede aught to you)? I desire not to do behind your backs that which I ask you not to do. I desire naught save reform so far as I am able. My welfare is only in Allah. In Him I trust and unto Him I turn (repentant).

explanation.bs: Šuajb: „Na Njega se oslanjam i Njemu se obraćam“ – okretanje Allahu bez spomena grijeha.
explanation.en: Shuʿayb: “In Him I trust and unto Him I turn” — turning to Allah with no sin in view.

quranTranslation.text: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;

explanation.bs: „Ne! Kunem se Danom kijameta“ – Allahova zakletva; tefsir se razilazi je li لَا pojačanje ili odbijanje tvrdnje poricatelja.
explanation.en: “Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection” — Allah's oath; tafsir differs on whether لَا is emphasis or a rejection of the deniers' claim.

quranTranslation.text: And they swear a solemn oath by Allah that if there come unto them a portent they will believe therein. Say; Portents are with Allah and (so is) that which telleth you that if such came unto them they would not believe.

explanation.bs: „I kunu se Allahom svojim najtežim zakletvama da će, ako im dođe znak, sigurno u njega vjerovati“ – zakletva nevjernika.
explanation.en: “And they swear a solemn oath by Allah that if there come unto them a portent they will believe therein” — the disbelievers' oath.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,

explanation.bs: Vlasnici vrta, „kad se zakleše da će ga sigurno obrati u svitanje“ – zakletva ljudi o vlastitoj namjeri.
explanation.en: The owners of the garden, “when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning” — people's oath about their own plan.

quranTranslation.text: And they swear by Allah that they are in truth of you, when they are not of you, but they are folk who are afraid.

explanation.bs: „I kunu se Allahom da su oni doista od vas, a nisu od vas“ – zakletva licemjera.
explanation.en: “They swear by Allah that they are in truth of you, when they are not of you” — the hypocrites' oath.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not seen those who take for friends a folk with whom Allah is wroth? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear a false oath knowingly.

explanation.bs: „…i kunu se na laž, a to znaju (يَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ)“ – zakletva uz laž.
explanation.en: “…and they swear a false oath knowingly” (يَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى الْكَذِبِ) — an oath bound to a lie.

quranTranslation.text: Allah will not take you to task for that which is unintentional in your oaths, but He will take you to task for the oaths which ye swear in earnest. The expiation thereof is the feeding of ten of the needy with the average of that wherewith ye feed your own folk, or the clothing of them, or the liberation of a slave, and for him who findeth not (the wherewithal to do so) then a three days' fast. This is the expiation of your oaths when ye have sworn; and keep your oaths. Thus Allah expoundeth unto you His revelations in order that ye may give thanks.

explanation.bs: „…to je iskup za vaše zakletve kad se zakunete“ – jedino neutralno mjesto: propis o zakletvi.
explanation.en: “…This is the expiation of your oaths when ye have sworn” — the one neutral place: the ruling on oaths.

quranTranslation.text: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them.

explanation.bs: „On je pustio dva mora: ovo je slatko, pitko, a ono slano, gorko“ – بَحْر i za slatku vodu.
explanation.en: “He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter” — بَحْر also of fresh water.

quranTranslation.text: And when We brought you through the sea and rescued you, and drowned the folk of Pharaoh in your sight.

explanation.bs: „I kad smo zbog vas more razdvojili…“ – بَحْر i u kazivanju o Musau.
explanation.en: “And when We brought you through the sea…” — بَحْر in the story of Moses too.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help.

explanation.bs: „Kad bi more bilo tinta za riječi Gospodara moga…“ – more kao slika neizmjernosti.
explanation.en: “Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord…” — the sea as an image of the boundless.

quranTranslation.text: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,

explanation.bs: „Stavi ga u sanduk, pa ga baci u rijeku (الْيَمّ)“ – tefsir: u Nil.
explanation.en: “Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river (الْيَمّ)” — tafsir: the Nile.

quranTranslation.text: And We inspired the mother of Moses, saying: Suckle him and, when thou fearest for him, then cast him into the river and fear not nor grieve. Lo! We shall bring him back unto thee and shall make him (one) of Our messengers.

explanation.bs: „…pa kad se pobojiš za njega, baci ga u rijeku i ne boj se“ – ista riječ, isto kazivanje (tefsir: Nil).
explanation.en: “When thou fearest for him, then cast him into the river and fear not” — the same word, the same story (tafsir: the Nile).

quranTranslation.text: Therefor We seized him and his hosts, and abandoned them unto the sea. Behold the nature of the consequence for evil-doers!

explanation.bs: „Pa smo njega i njegovu vojsku uhvatili i bacili ih u more“ – faraonov kraj.
explanation.en: “Therefor We seized him and his hosts, and abandoned them unto the sea” — Pharaoh's end.

quranTranslation.text: We shall cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve because they ascribe unto Allah partners, for which no warrant hath been revealed. Their habitation is the Fire, and hapless the abode of the wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „U srca onih koji ne vjeruju ubacit ćemo užas, zbog toga što Allahu pripisuju druge“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “We shall cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve because they ascribe unto Allah partners” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep, and We caused them to turn over to the right and the left, and their dog stretching out his paws on the threshold. If thou hadst observed them closely thou hadst assuredly turned away from them in flight, and hadst been filled with awe of them.

explanation.bs: „Da si ih ugledao, sigurno bi od njih pobjegao i užasom bi se ispunio“ – ar-Rāġib: slika ispunjenosti.
explanation.en: “If thou hadst observed them closely thou hadst assuredly turned away from them in flight, and hadst been filled with awe [terror] of them” — ar-Rāġib: the image of being filled.

quranTranslation.text: Whoso bringeth a good deed will have better than its worth; and such are safe from fear that Day.

explanation.bs: „Ko dođe s dobrim djelom, njemu pripada nešto bolje od njega, a takvi će toga Dana biti sigurni od prepasti.“
explanation.en: “Whoso bringeth a good deed will have better than its worth; and such are safe from fear [alarm] that Day.”

quranTranslation.text: And when the awe departed from Abraham, and the glad news reached him, he pleaded with Us on behalf of the folk of Lot.

explanation.bs: „Pa kad je Ibrahima strepnja napustila i stigla mu radosna vijest…“ – strepnja koju je osjetio kad gosti nisu htjeli jesti (11:70); ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And when the awe [fright] departed from Abraham, and the glad news reached him…” — the fright he felt when his guests would not eat (11:70); ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: So he escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.

explanation.bs: Musa „izađe iz njega u strahu, iščekujući“ – napušta grad; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Moses “escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant” — he leaves the city; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.

explanation.bs: „Iz njihovih utroba izlazi piće različitih boja.“
explanation.en: “There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues.”

quranTranslation.text: They will wish to come forth from the Fire, but they will not come forth from it. Theirs will be a lasting doom.

explanation.bs: „Poželjet će da izađu iz Vatre, no nikako iz nje neće izaći“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “They will wish to come forth from the Fire, but they will not come forth from it” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And when they went into the field against Goliath and his hosts they said: Our Lord! Bestow on us endurance, make our foothold sure, and give us help against the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: Talutovi vojnici „kad izađoše na otvoreno pred Džaluta i vojsku njegovu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Saul's soldiers “when they went into the field against Goliath and his hosts” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then, after grief, He sent down security for you. As slumber did it overcome a party of you, while (the other) party, who were anxious on their own account, thought wrongly of Allah, the thought of ignorance. They said: Have we any part in the cause? Say (O Muhammad): The cause belongeth wholly to Allah. They hide within themselves (a thought) which they reveal not unto thee, saying: Had we had any part in the cause we should not have been slain here. Say: Even though ye had been in your houses, those appointed to be slain would have gone forth to the places where they were to lie. (All this hath been) in order that Allah might try what is in your breasts and prove what is in your hearts. Allah is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men).

explanation.bs: „Oni kojima je bilo propisano da poginu istupili bi prema mjestima gdje će pasti“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Those appointed to be slain would have gone forth to the places where they were to lie” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty,

explanation.bs: „… i istupit će pred Allaha, Jedinog, Svemoćnog“ – otkriveni pred Njim; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty” — uncovered before Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;

explanation.bs: „I oni koji, kad troše, ne pretjeruju niti škrtare, nego je između toga sredina“ – mjera između dvije krajnosti; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging” — the measure between two extremes; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to exceed the bounds, to be prodigal

quranTranslation.text: O Children of Adam! Look to your adornment at every place of worship, and eat and drink, but be not prodigal. Lo! He loveth not the prodigals.

explanation.bs: „Jedite i pijte, ali ne pretjerujte“ – pretjerivanje i izvan imetka.
explanation.en: “Eat and drink, but be not prodigal” — exceeding the bounds beyond wealth too.

gloss.en: to exceed the bounds, to be prodigal

quranTranslation.text: And slay not the life which Allah hath forbidden save with right. Whoso is slain wrongfully, We have given power unto his heir, but let him not commit excess in slaying. Lo! he will be helped.

explanation.bs: „… neka ne pretjeruje u ubijanju“ – ar-Rāġib kaže: da ne ubije nekog drugog osim ubice, ili više od njega.
explanation.en: “But let him not commit excess in slaying” — ar-Rāġib says: by killing someone other than the killer, or more than him.

gloss.en: to exceed the bounds, to be prodigal

quranTranslation.text: Give the kinsman his due, and the needy, and the wayfarer, and squander not (thy wealth) in wantonness.

explanation.bs: „Daj rođaku njegovo pravo, i siromahu, i putniku, i ne rasipaj rasipanjem“ – nakon davanja onima kojima pripada; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Give the kinsman his due, and the needy, and the wayfarer, and squander not (thy wealth) in wantonness” — after giving to those it belongs to; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.

explanation.bs: „… On zna tajnu i ono što je još skrivenije“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Those who spend their wealth by night and day, by stealth and openly, verily their reward is with their Lord, and their shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.

explanation.bs: „Oni koji dijele imetke svoje noću i danju, tajno i javno …“ – tajno, kao suprotnost javnom; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj par riječi.
explanation.en: “Those who spend their wealth by night and day, by stealth and openly” — in secret, as the opposite of openly; ar-Rāġib cites this pair of words.

quranTranslation.text: Know they not that Allah knoweth both their secret and the thought that they confide, and that Allah is the Knower of Things Hidden?

explanation.bs: „Zar ne znaju da Allah zna njihovu tajnu i njihovo došaptavanje …“ – obje riječi zajedno: ono u duši i ono nasamo rečeno.
explanation.en: “Allah knoweth both their secret and the thought that they confide” — both words together: what is in the soul and what is said apart.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things.

explanation.bs: „… Nema došaptavanja trojice a da On nije četvrti …“ – Allah zna i ono što se govori nasamo, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “There is no secret conference [najwā] of three but He is their fourth” — Allah knows even what is said apart, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?

explanation.bs: „… I nasamo su se došaptavali …“ – ar-Rāġib: nisu to ni na koji način otkrili, jer se došaptavanje ponekad kasnije otkrije.
explanation.en: “And they confer in secret” — ar-Rāġib: they did not disclose it in any way, since such counsel sometimes comes out later.

quranTranslation.text: There is no good in much of their secret conferences save (in) him who enjoineth almsgiving and kindness and peace-making among the people. Whoso doeth that, seeking the good pleasure of Allah, We shall bestow on him a vast reward.

explanation.bs: „Nema dobra u mnogim njihovim došaptavanjima, osim kod onoga ko naređuje sadaku, dobro ili mirenje među ljudima …“
explanation.en: “There is no good in much of their secret conferences save (in) him who enjoineth almsgiving and kindness and peace-making among the people.”
